title: Warehouse pick and pack
summary: Orders are picked five to a cart by pickers who work in shifts, then packed one by one. See what batching costs, and what a thin night shift does to the wait.
origin: Written for this project: a pick-and-pack warehouse with carts of five orders and day and night shifts, a new model rather than an extension of examples/warehouse.json; answers from the batch wait (n - 1)/(2 lambda), the shift table and flow conservation (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
